issues.what: not the same surface: granule cells sit in different places and are rounder and softer, lanes are shallow brown instead of narrow black, and the field is about 15 lum darker with duller crests
issues.fix: rebuild this ground from the approved cell layout, put the micro-ridges and inky lanes back, and lift exposure until the crests are golden-white again

issues.what: cells do not correspond to the approved crop; texture is waxy and low-contrast, and fine detail is down by about a third
issues.fix: match cell positions, sharpen the ridges inside each granule, and narrow the lanes to near-black

issues.what: fibrils and cells are in the wrong places; the upper-left flow is broad smeared bands instead of needle filaments, and fine detail is down by about 40 percent
issues.fix: realign the flow to the approved tracks, split the smears into thin bright filaments, and restore white-gold peaks against black gaps

issues.what: umbra is smaller and rounder, the right penumbra is smeared into thick streaks, surrounding granules do not match, and local contrast is compressed
issues.fix: restore the jagged umbra and fine radial fibrils, put the approved granule field back, and open the range so lanes go black and crests go bright

issues.what: penumbra reads as thick blunt spokes, loop threads and the limb are softer, and highlights are dull bronze instead of gold
issues.fix: thin the penumbra into needle fibrils, sharpen the umbra edge and loop strands, and lift filament highlights

issues.what: spicules are a regular comb of straight triangular spikes, and the disk below is muddy and low-contrast
issues.fix: replace the spike row with irregular soft wisps of varying height and restore granule crests and dark lanes

issues.what: the faint arcade over the limb is missing, spicules are a rigid picket fence, and the surface is soft
issues.fix: put the faint secondary loops back, break the spike row into turbulent wisps, and sharpen the granules

issues.where: both eruption footpoints and the near limb
issues.what: surface shading under the loops is flatter than the approved frame, and the spicule fringe is more rigid and less detailed
issues.fix: restore crisp granule relief at both footpoints and soften the limb into uneven plasma wisps

issues.what: crests have lost gold-white and the midtones have shifted toward muddy orange
issues.fix: warm the highlights back to incandescent gold without lifting the black lanes
